description: Mystery arc part 1/2: the running joke of one more mission before the mystery, then chat votes on the mystery and Windah counts to ten. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-misteriarc1/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-misteriarc1.mp4): nine pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live8/stream-2204-2304.mp4 (h4) and stream-2304-2346.mp4 (p5) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 2263.70-2264.90 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 1943.65-1945.70 = local 3.00-5.05 -> output 1.20-3.25; B t 1956.25-1961.85 = local 6.25-11.85 -> output 3.25-8.85; C t 2068.30-2074.95 = local 13.05-19.70 -> output 8.85-15.50; D t 3263.45-3268.00 = local 20.90-25.45 -> output 15.50-20.05; E1 t 1742.00-1746.10 = local 26.65-30.75 -> output 20.05-24.15; E2 t 1773.60-1778.45 = local 31.95-36.80 -> output 24.15-29.00; E3 t 1783.20-1786.60 = local 38.00-41.40 -> output 29.00-32.40; F t 1788.20-1791.40 = local 42.60-45.80 -> output 32.40-35.60. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (p5 37:44, the pineapple-shaped bus stop from the car, 1.2 s); the running joke 'satu misi lagi, abis itu misteri' (h4 32:24, 32:36, 34:28), 'kalau dicari terus misinya berat' (54:23); chat votes on the mystery and he counts to ten (p5 29:02-29:46, jump-count); cliffhanger 'gue Google tapi gue gak spoiler' (29:48). Word timings from short-window faster-whisper medium with VAD. CUT: the vote's option names (a cartoon character, p5 29:06, 29:26) and every spoken character name; 'anjir' at p5 30:08 and 33:48 (outside the cuts); h4 34:56-35:00 'misi dulu' (a strip-club street with an 'adult entertainment' sign) and the first 2 s of 54:21 (a van marked WTF). The game crop (656,0,864) leaves out the browser poll/chat window with usernames and the Windows taskbar. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame. Main 35.60 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 864x486 at (656,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'SATU MISI LAGI, SUMPAH', line 2 Volt 'HABIS ITU MISTERI', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
